notice: Synthetic test inputs only. This file records what the code accepts and shows. It is not a live observation, not connectivity, entitlement or production acceptance, and not a real-model acceptance of the 18 research roles.
description: Coverage list of the live research model (live-research.mjs, MarketResearch), for card R4 step 5, "Publish the actual coverage matrix with unknown fields retained." For each of the eight assets and six dimensions it records the status before any source answers and when every connected source answers with valid data, including the public news and social answers that reach the model through ingestPublic, the provider name exactly as the code writes it, the time fields and time basis each kept item carries, and the history and freshness bounds the code holds for each source. A provider fact the code does not hold stays null (see unknown_fields). Each text is a pair [zh, en]: research-coverage.test.mjs compares the Chinese half in the zh locale and the English half in the en locale. The test fails when the code changes the model's mode or a source, status, provider name, time field, text or bound recorded here, until this file is updated; the facts listed under by_reading, and the line locations, are recorded by reading and no assertion holds them.

meaning.display_rights: whether and how this provider's data may be shown to users
meaning.quota: how much this provider allows to be read
meaning.rate_limit: this provider's request rate limit; the code holds no number for it: the relay only reacts to HTTP 429 and Retry-After (market-hub-relay.mjs L133-L134, L162), LunarCrush's HTTP 429 becomes a RATE_LIMIT error (public-lunarcrush.mjs L29), and a failed news or social read is answered 503 with Retry-After 60 and not asked upstream again for 60 s (licensed-feeds.mjs L53, L68)
meaning.expiry: when the right to use this provider's data ends; not the evidence validity windows recorded under sources

not_recorded.case: a valid context answer without a row for an asset in the source's scope, for example a chains answer with an Ethereum row only
not_recorded.reason: how it should read next to a source that was never connected is not decided, so no expected value is recorded or tested

not_recorded.case: the value of publicVersion inside the sourceId of the public item
not_recorded.reason: it counts the changes to the asset's public facts since the model started (an answer that changes them, a fact that ends), so it depends on what the page read before; the test reads it from the model and checks only the form of the sourceId. Reading each answer once, in either order, does not change it

not_recorded.case: the model's own limits on what it keeps of its past: task.history holds at most the 5 newest earlier versions of each task, and events at most the 32 newest log entries
not_recorded.reason: version and log limits, not data history: they bound the model's record of its own updates, not the history a source answers or research accepts (the history entries under sources). live-research.test.mjs L115 and L197 already hold both limits, so this test does not repeat them
